summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The HCM Hedged Equity ETF (HAWG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in large-cap US companies while using an option overlay and a quantitative model to manage market exposure. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation. HAWG was launched on Aug 13, 2026 and is issued by HCM.
